data.gender_notes: Nesayem is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nesayem is derived from the Arabic root 'N-S-M', meaning 'to breathe' or 'to be gentle'. In Islamic tradition, the name is believed to symbolize the delicate nature of creation, as well as the grace and compassion of Allah. The name Nesayem carries the meaning “Graceful, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nesayem usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
